governance.note: Active levers all trace to measured inputs: CAMPD unit-level net-load-filtered outage windows (campd-unit-outages.csv, exogenous availability keyed on net load, not price), measured ERCOT 60-Day DAM Disclosure AS series driving the energy+reserve co-optimization, measured per-resource-type storage up-AS reservation (storage_as_commitment) and the measured load-resource RRS-UFR credit, EIA-860 BTM CHP host steam pulled out of the LP (btm.parquet), measured F923/Henry-Hub fuel prices. No adder/haircut/sigmoid tuned to the price or volume residual; no unit pinned to its observed CEMS generation; no input rescaled so the model output lands on actuals.
